Ivy: Heads-up from GCP marketplace ops — customer ZeroScale reports their committed usage tier didn't apply for invoice dated 2026-06-11. They were billed at list price.

Liam: Which invoice/account?

Ivy: GC-INV-20260611-1204, account zeroscale-enterprise-9. Their CSV shows 'pricing_bucket' = 'standard' instead of 'committed'.

Nora: Any $$$ impact?

Ivy: Rough calc: $18,900 additional charges for the month.

Vik: Could be our tier-mapping service failing during the daily pricing refresh. I saw an NPE in the pricing-refresh job earlier today.

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-4680 for ZeroScale GCP pricing bucket mismatch. Priority: P2. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-4680

Liam: Can you paste a sample row?

Ivy: Sample (sanitized):
```
account,sku,event_ts,quantity,pricing_bucket
zeroscale-enterprise-9,gcp-tokens,2026-06-10T22:00:00Z,125000,standard
```
Their expected pricing_bucket should be 'committed-100k'.

Vik: Confirmed — pricing-refresh failed at 2026-06-10T21:58Z due to a null pointer when loading partner_contracts. Fix incoming.

Nora: For customer experience, finance ok to provision a credit memo covering the delta? Need approval.

Jared: Approve provisional credit $18,900 pending final audit. GL tags: marketplace_rebates, partner_channel, pending_adjustment.

Ivy: I'll create CM-20260611-ZS9 and set status pending. Will hold final reversing entry until post-fix audit.

Vik: Deploying hotfix to pricing-refresh now, will rerun mapping and produce a corrected usage export. ETA 45m.

Nora: Once corrected file available, we'll reconcile and either finalize the credit or adjust if numbers differ.

Ivy: Notifying ZeroScale with provisional memo ref and expected timeline.

billing-bot: BILL-4680 updated: status=investigating, assignee=Vik.

Liam: Thx. Add a postmortem item to ensure pricing-refresh alerting triggers on NPEs so it doesn't silently default.

Ivy: Loop closed for now — next check 2026-06-11T13:00Z.
